counterargs.read: Today's move looks like a real-rate/duration story rather than a credit or inflation scare: yields rose broadly while breakevens stayed flat, and the credit-proxy weakness (ALLY/CACC/COF) hasn't yet shown up in HY OAS itself. The MOVE breakout above 70 is the single most notable signal and worth watching into the Aug 20 H.4.1 print and the Aug 27-29 Jackson Hole symposium — if it's the start of a real vol regime shift rather than a one-day pre-data air pocket.

trade_table.rationale: SOXX/SPY ratio at 0.724 vs 0.709 yesterday — relative strength intact, but rising real yields are a headwind for long-duration growth names.
Yields rising across the curve into the Aug 20 H.4.1 print; TLT/SHY ratio slipped to 0.992 from 1.001.
ALLY/CACC/COF all down 2.4-2.9% in one session while HY OAS stays tight — a proxy/index divergence worth confirming over the next few sessions.
Gate now 2/3 — EWY cleared its 20-day SMA (185.10 vs 166.79) and USDKRW stays well below 1,530; KOSPI (6,869.84) remains the lone holdout vs the 8,200 threshold.

duration_score.classification: Real-Rate/Vol Firming — Yields and MOVE Both Break Higher
duration_score.reason: Nominal yields extended higher across the whole curve (2Y +0.33%, 10Y +0.21%, 30Y +0.11%) while T10YIE/T5YIE and DFII5 stayed flat, again pointing to a real-rate/term-premium move rather than a fresh inflation scare. The new wrinkle is MOVE's break above 70 (+8.70%) alongside a same-day 2.4-2.9% pullback in ALLY/CACC/COF — the first time this run that rates, vol, and credit proxies have moved together, even though HY OAS itself hasn't confirmed.

james_framework.what_market_IS_saying: Yields and bond-market vol firming together while breakevens and DFII5 stay flat — still a real-rate/term-premium story, but the vol confirmation is new.

james_framework.watch_signal: If nominal 2Y starts falling while MOVE stays elevated → transition to a growth-scare/cuts narrative; if DFII5 breaks higher alongside MOVE, that reopens the real-rate pain trade.
